description: The bar chart illustrates the sample counts for four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—categorized by two writing styles: “Open” (light blue) and “Cons.” (conservative, light red), as part of the EssayBench evaluation framework for large language models in multi-genre Chinese essay writing. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” ranges from 0 to 130 with tick marks at intervals of 20. For Argumentative essays, the Open style has 79 samples and the Conservative style has 122; for Narrative, Open has 80 and Conservative has 87; for Descriptive, Open has 68 and Conservative has 100; and for Expository, Open has 62 and Conservative has 130. The bars are grouped by genre along the horizontal axis, with each pair of bars showing the comparative sample sizes for the two styles. Conservative-style essays consistently outnumber Open-style essays across all genres, with the largest disparity observed in Expository essays (130 vs. 62). The chart uses a simple grouped bar layout with a legend in the upper right corner identifying the color coding for each style.
